overview_description.description: Kennedy Towers is a large provider of short term rental accommodation in the UAE. Kennedy Towers seeks to advance the sharing economy by pursuing greater standards of property presentation and superior levels of customer service to ensure greater value is delivered to both landlords and guests.  It is a joint venture between Kennedy Property and Edwards and Towers, two of the UAE's leading Real Estate Service providers. Kennedy Towers seeks to advance the sharing economy by pursuing greater standards of property presentation and superior levels of customer service to ensure greater value is delivered to both landlords and guests.
